steps.code:
from primitives import call

result = call(
    name="submit_capx_action",
    action="get_object_pose",
    native_api=True,
    parameters={"object_name": "brown spill", "return_bbox_extent": True},
)
if result.ok:
    print(result.output)
else:
    print("get_object_pose failed")

moves = [
    [0.4654, -0.0700, 0.1500],
    [0.4654, -0.0700, 0.0600],
    [0.4654, -0.0700, 0.0000],
]
for p in moves:
    r = call(
        name="submit_capx_action",
        action="goto_pose",
        native_api=True,
        parameters={"position": p, "quaternion_wxyz": [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0]},
    )
    print("move", p, "ok", r.ok, "output", r.output if r.ok else "failed")
    if not r.ok:
        break

obs = call(
    name="observe_capx_scene",
    agent_context=None,
    prompt=None,
    query="Return current end-effector position, contact state, proportion wiped, wipe centroid and wipe radius.",
)
if obs.ok:
    data = obs.output
    print(data)
else:
    print("observation failed")

get_object_pose.doc:
Get the pose of an object in the environment from a natural language description.
The quaternion from get_object_pose may be unreliable, so disregard it and use the grasp pose quaternion OR (0, 0, 1, 0) wxyz as the gripper down orientation if using this for placement position.

Args:
    object_name: The name of the object to get the pose of.
    return_bbox_extent:  Whether to return the extent of the oriented bounding box (oriented by quaternion_wxyz). Default is False.

Returns:
    position: (3,) XYZ in meters.
    quaternion_wxyz: (4,) WXYZ unit quaternion.
    bbox_extent: (3,) XYZ in meters (full side length, not half-length extent). If return_bbox_extent is False, returns None.

goto_pose.doc:
Go to pose using Inverse Kinematics.
There is no need to call a second goto_pose with the same position and quaternion_wxyz after calling it with z_approach.
Args:
    position: (3,) XYZ in meters.
    quaternion_wxyz: (4,) WXYZ unit quaternion.
Returns:
    None

steps.title: capx action · capx scene
steps.code:
# Wipe three closely spaced rows across the upper part of the measured spill bounds.
q = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
x_left = 0.3415
x_right = 0.5893
ys = [-0.070, -0.100, -0.130]
current_x = 0.4654
failed = False

for row_index in range(len(ys)):
    y = ys[row_index]
    target_x = x_left if row_index % 2 == 0 else x_right
    steps = 7
    start_x = current_x
    for j in range(1, steps + 1):
        x = start_x + (target_x - start_x) * j / steps
        r = call(
            name="submit_capx_action",
            action="goto_pose",
            native_api=True,
            parameters={"position": [x, y, 0.0], "quaternion_wxyz": q},
        )
        if not r.ok:
            print("failed", row_index, j)
            failed = True
            break
    current_x = target_x
    if failed:
        break

obs2 = call(
    name="observe_capx_scene",
    agent_context=None,
    prompt=None,
    query="current public observation",
)
if obs2.ok:
    out = obs2.output
    if "public_observation" in out:
        po = out["public_observation"]
        print("progress", po.get("proportion_wiped"), "eef", po.get("robot0_eef_pos"), "contact", po.get("robot0_contact"))
    elif "data" in out and "public_observation" in out["data"]:
        po = out["data"]["public_observation"]
        print("progress", po.get("proportion_wiped"), "eef", po.get("robot0_eef_pos"), "contact", po.get("robot0_contact"))
    else:
        print("obs keys", list(out.keys()))
else:
    print("observe failed")

q = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
x_left = 0.3415

ys_lower = [-0.160, -0.190, -0.220, -0.250, -0.278]
current_x = x_left

for row_index in range(len(ys_lower)):
    y = ys_lower[row_index]
    target_x = x_right if row_index % 2 == 0 else x_left
    start_x = current_x
    for j in range(1, 8):
        x = start_x + (target_x - start_x) * j / 7.0
        r = call(
            name="submit_capx_action",
            action="goto_pose",
            native_api=True,
            parameters={
                "position": [x, y, 0.0],
                "quaternion_wxyz": q,
            },
        )
        if not r.ok:
            print("wipe failed at row", row_index, "step", j)
